text: Level three, question six: in a four hundred metre race, A beats B by forty metres, and B beats C by twenty metres; by how much does A beat C? Question seven: three cyclists complete one lap of a circular track in two, three and four minutes; they start together from the same point in the same direction; when are they first together again at the starting point, and how many laps has the fastest completed by then? Question eight: in a two hundred metre race, A beats B by twenty metres and beats C by thirty-eight metres; by how much would B beat C in a two hundred metre race?
